description: Full region-code search pool after deduplication; this is the full raw REG video dataset used as the starting point for filtering.
Same 16,844-video pool as RAW-REG, with an added is_iberian flag documenting records retained or rejected during filtering/labelling decisions.
Clean post-filtered REG candidate dataset after language and Iberian locality filters; not manually validated as all Iberian.
REG videos labelled as Iberia-relevant/TRUE after the filtering and labelling process.

Geotag/location-based anchor derived from older source-flagged working files by selecting source_flag == GEO or BOTH. The same 305 GEO/BOTH video IDs were present across all comparable source-flag datasets. This file documents the GEO pathway but is not identical to the current final LABEL paper dataset.
Final manually curated Iberia-relevant video-level corpus used by the manuscript workflow; 1,895 distinct videos from 1,002 channels and 94 species.
